title: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness - Pre Vocational Studies - Packaging Criteria
exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The process of wrapping or enclosing agricultural produce in suitable materials to protect it from damage during transportation and sale is known as ________.
questions.explain: Packaging is the science and art of enclosing or protecting agricultural products for distribution, storage, sale, and use.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following criteria is most critical when deciding the type of packaging material to use for farm produce?
options: The personal preference of the farm workers
The nature and shape of the produce
The time of day the produce was harvested
The age of the farm manager
questions.explain: The physical nature (solid or liquid) and shape of the produce are primary criteria that dictate whether a bag, tray, box, or drum is suitable for packaging.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: When transporting a large volume of liquid agricultural produce, such as palm oil or fresh milk, which of the following packaging items is most appropriate?
questions.explain: Drums and barrels are strong, leak-proof, and specifically designed to hold and transport bulky liquids like palm oil.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: A farmer needs to transport fifty live broiler chickens to a distant market. The best packaging item to ensure their safe delivery is ________.
questions.explain: Live stock requires proper air circulation to survive. Ventilated cages or crates protect the birds while allowing them to breathe freely.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Packaging crates and trays are highly recommended for transporting fresh eggs primarily because ________.
options: Eggs need intense sunlight exposure during transport
They are fragile and require individual compartments to prevent cracking
Trays make the eggs hatch faster on the way to the market
questions.explain: Eggs have very brittle shells. Trays provide padded, individual compartments that absorb shock and keep the eggs from colliding and breaking.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: How does the 'distance to market' affect the choice of packaging for agricultural produce?
options: Longer distances require stronger, more durable packaging to withstand transport stress
Short distances always require expensive imported glass containers
Produce sold nearby must always be frozen
Distance has absolutely no effect on packaging
questions.explain: The farther the market, the more handling and shaking the produce will endure. Thus, longer distances demand highly robust and protective packaging materials.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Which of the following is an example of an agricultural product that is best packaged in sealed polythene bags to prevent it from absorbing moisture?
questions.explain: Dry stock, like garri or beans, can spoil or grow mold if exposed to moisture. Polythene bags offer an airtight seal that keeps water out.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: The 'bulkiness' of farm produce is a packaging criterion that refers to its ________, which directly determines the capacity and strength of the container required.
questions.explain: Bulkiness relates to how large and heavy (size and volume) a product is, which dictates how large the box, bag, or drum must be.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Fresh fish that is to be transported over a long distance without spoiling is best packaged and handled as ________.
questions.explain: Fish deteriorates very quickly. Transporting it as frozen stock inside insulated containers stops bacterial action and preserves freshness.
questions.exam: BECE Pre-Vocational Studies: Animal Feeding, Fishery, Forestry & Agribusiness
questions.subject: Pre Vocational Studies

questions.q: Aside from protecting the produce, what is another significant advantage of proper packaging in agricultural marketing?
options: It completely prevents all future diseases
It eliminates the need for farming altogether
It improves the physical presentation and attracts potential buyers
It drastically reduces the weight of the food
questions.explain: Good, clean, and well-designed packaging acts as a form of advertising, making the product visually appealing and encouraging consumers to buy.
